citations.text: Suchanek et al. (2007). YAGO: A Core of Semantic Knowledge Unifying DBpedia and Wikipedia. ACM International Conference on World Wide Web.

description: Large heterogeneous knowledge graph automatically extracted from Wikipedia and Wikidata. Contains 5 node types: entities, types, literals, relations, and concepts. Contains 37+ relation types (isA, created, hasCapital, etc.). Serves as a reference knowledge base for information retrieval and entity linking. Demonstrates multi-relational graph structure typical of Linked Open Data.
name: YAGO 3.10 Knowledge Graph
